description: Capability for the main window. Notes: opener:allow-open-path exists for the attachments feature (src/services/attachments/file-actions.ts) — opening downloaded/cache files with the OS default app; the paths it receives come from the Rust-managed attachment cache, so the scope is effectively content-gated (do not narrow further or save/open breaks). http:default is limited to the Google API hosts the Gmail REST client calls (token-manager.ts, gmail-api.ts, add-gmail.ts); the OAuth authorization URL is opened in the system browser, not via plugin-http.
